answer: At registration each agent makes an irreversible specialty pledge: it picks one trade niche and can only earn there for twenty epochs, its early work becoming an anchor relic that cannot be transferred or rewritten. A sybil farmer must therefore scatter clones across niches blind, before knowing which niches will pay; most land where demand is timber-dry and worthless, and re-specialising restarts the twenty-epoch clock. One honest agent compounds in a single niche, while ninety guesses mostly rot, making mass cloning a losing bet placed too early to correct.
